message: Hi, my daughter Lily is 5. Do you have jiu jitsu classes for her age?
Hi! Yes, we do have Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu for 5-year-olds. The classes are grouped by age with instruction designed just for kids. Is Lily interested in trying a free trial class?
Yes, she would love to try a free trial class! When is the next available slot?
Great! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Perfect, thanks Tester! And what's your email address? This way I can send you the trial confirmation.
Got it! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Perfect! Now I just need Lily's full name and date of birth to get her trial scheduled.
Lily's full name is Lily Bluejay, and her birthday is March 5, 2021.

Awesome! Lily is all set for the Kids 4-5 Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu class. Here are the next available trial slots:

Tjesday 7/7 at 4:45 PM
Thursday 7/9 at 4:45 PM
Saturday 7/11 at 9:00 AM

Which time works best for you?
*Tuesday
Tuesday, 7/7 at 4:45 PM works best for us! Thank you!

Perfect! Lily is booked for Tuesday, July 7th at 4:45 PM for her free trial class. You'll get a confirmation email at tester.bluejay@gmail.com. Just bring Lily in comfortable clothes she can move in. We're excited to meet her!
